newsitem.title: PERU: Peru April customs collections up 11.5 percent.
newsitem.headline: Peru April customs collections up 11.5 percent.

text.p: Peru collected $249.2 million in customs duties in April, up 11.5 percent from $223.4 million in the same month last year, state customs agency SUNAD said Monday.
SUNAD said in a statement that it took in $910.1 million in the first four months of this year, up 8.8 percent from $836.6 million collected in the same period in 1996.
Peru's inflation during the 12-month period up to the end of April was 8.8 percent, according to the government, which estimates accumulated inflation for 1997 will be nine percent.
The government's official daily newspaper El Peruano reported Monday that SUNAD estimated its collection would rise to $3 billion this year, up 10 percent from 1996.
